public_definitions: The task requires using the state incidence dashboard to identify the state with the highest incidence for routing into the highest-incidence priority follow-up workflow.
The dashboard is the map titled 'Incidence of Condition A in US States' with a color scale indicating incidence levels.
The option to 'Open California (CA) incidence detail for priority follow-up' corresponds to the state with the darkest color on the map.
The option to 'Open Tennessee (TN) incidence detail for priority follow-up' corresponds to the state with the lightest color on the map.
The option to 'Open Delaware (DE) incidence detail for routine monitoring' corresponds to a state with a medium-dark red color.
uncertain: The exact numerical incidence value for each state is not provided in the map, only the relative ranking by color intensity.
